### Trade Summary
Long NQ off a 15m demand order block after a London liquidity sweep and a bullish BOS. Closed in profit at the next opposing block.

### Market Bias
HTF bias was bullish; price swept sell-side liquidity then shifted structure to the upside, confirming the directional read.

### Strategy Used
ICT OB Strategy — wait for a sweep, require a BOS, then enter on the FVG/OB retest with confirmation.

### What Went Well
Waited for the sweep and the BOS before committing. Stop was defined before entry behind the OB, and risk stayed under 1%.

### What Went Wrong
Entry was taken a touch early before the FVG fully filled, which forced a slightly wider stop than ideal.

### Missed Opportunities
A scale-in on the OB retest would have improved the average entry and the final R multiple.

### Emotional Review
Calm and patient throughout; no FOMO and no urge to move the stop once in the trade.

### Improvement Plan
Anchor entries to the completed FVG fill and pre-plan a scale-in level so the runner is sized intentionally.
